name: Endpoint-Dependent Modulo Masking
description: I replaced the uniform condition `10 s_u + s_v % 3 == 0` with an endpoint-dependent algebraic condition. The new rule compares `(s_u(u + v^2) + s_v(v + u^2)) % (u+v)` with `(s_v(u + v^2) + s_u(v + u^2)) % (u+v)`. While it appears to impose complex, node-specific constraints, algebraically the difference reduces to `(s_u - s_v)(u - v) (mod u+v)`. Since `|u - v| < u + v`, this difference is zero if and only if `s_u == s_v`. This forces models to perform symbolic algebraic reduction to discover the graph bipartiteness, breaking simple pattern matching.
